guarantee.label: 90-Day Performance Guarantee
guarantee.definition: If agreed KPIs (defined in the scope of work) are not met within 90 days of campaign launch, DigiMinds continues work at no additional management fee until targets are met or client is refunded management fees for months that missed targets. Ad spend is never refunded — it belongs to the platform.
conditions: Minimum ad spend commitment met by client
Access to all ad accounts, CRM, and analytics maintained
KPI framework signed off at kick-off
No major scope changes by client mid-flight

pricing_framework.public_pricing_policy: No fixed public pricing — custom scoped per engagement
pricing_framework.invoicing: Monthly advance invoice; enterprise 50% kickoff / 50% day-30 available; PKR or USD

team_and_credentials.leadership: Founder-led; Fractional CMO model means senior strategists on every account
team_and_credentials.team_size_range: 15–40 specialists (paid media, creative, tracking, content, account management)
team_and_credentials.on_account_staffing: Senior strategist + paid media lead + creative/tracking support per client — no junior-only pods
team_and_credentials.availability: PK business hours + overlap with US PT/ET via dedicated account managers; UK/EU hours covered; WhatsApp Business response <30 min during business hours

case_study_templates.instruction_for_chatbot: Use only these templated outcome statements until DigiMinds provides specific client names. Never invent brand names. Offer to send full case study PDF after email capture.
case_study_templates.dtc_skincare: Scaled a private-label skincare brand from USD 22k/mo to USD 180k/mo in 7 months — 4.1x blended ROAS, server-side tracking recovery restored 38% of pixel-lost events.
case_study_templates.hvac_contractor: 14 HVAC contractors onboarded in 18 months — average cost-per-booked-job reduced from USD 220 to USD 68 via geo-intent Google Ads + GHL appointment automation.
case_study_templates.b2b_saas: Mid-market SaaS: MQL volume +217% in 90 days, SQL conversion rate doubled after LinkedIn + Google intent layering and HubSpot–ad-platform closed-loop.
case_study_templates.b2c_relocation: International relocation service: quote-request CPL cut 61% across US/UAE corridors via multi-language Meta + Google PMax with consented first-party data.
case_study_templates.tracking_rescue: Ecom brand losing 42% of attribution post-iOS14.5 — restored to 91% accuracy in 3 weeks via sGTM + CAPI + consent mode v2, unlocked USD 2.3M/yr in better budget decisions.
